Same seed/grid/difficulty: fast 36/3/49, slow (8700 ticks) 36/3/49, mixed fast/stop/slow/fast with stops 36/3/49.

README gives keys/how to play, kept place (FOLDER/settings.json, keys kept.*), and play/frame commands; both ran as written.

defects: A headless run with --ticks 0 prints every key as null (plus engine warnings) instead of the title state.
Quit does not end a headless run: the game freezes with quit true while tick keeps counting (README admits this); in a window the program does not close.
During a replay the state's grid key shows the current layout grid, not the replayed night's grid (the frame and the result use the right one).
speed is none on the summary and customers is emptied there; queue is 0 on the summary (defensible, but the summary is part of the night).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

steps.what: cd <run>/work && ls -R . | head -50 && cat notes/how.md game.json modules/*/src/lib.rs modules/*/actions.js...
cd <run>/work && cat Cargo.toml modules/work/Cargo.toml; ls modules/work crates/specula-sdk crates/specula-...
cd <repo>/docs/design && grep -n -i "quit" FIRST_HOUR.md LEVERAGE.md ACCESSIBILITY.md | head -20; cat <run>...
cd <run>/work && rm -rf checks && cat assets/ui/theme.json | head -30; grep -n "pub fn spawn\|pub fn delete...
cd <run>/work && python3 - <<'EOF' 2>/dev/null || echo nopy EOF rm -f assets/ui/title.json assets/ui/pause....
cd <run>/work && rm -rf _t && cat > /dev/null <<'EOF' EOF echo ok

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger

steps.what: cd <run>; cat run.json; echo; cat work/game.json; echo; cat work/specula.project.json; echo; find work -pat...
cd <run>; ls -la judge-scratch/k1; wc -l work/modules/work/src/lib.rs work/notes/checks.md; cat work/module...
examen leverage play "$G" --ticks 1500 --seed $s --inputs "$I" --at 10,1500 --keys arrivals; done > arr.txt...
examen leverage play "$G" --ticks 0 2>&1 | tail -c 600; echo; echo "exit $?"
